content: परिपक्व {%<ab>p. p.</ab>%} .²1 Completely cooked. .²2 Completely baked or burnt. .²3 Quite ripe, mature, perfected (<ab>fig.</ab> also); प्रफुल्ललोध्रः परिपक्वशालिः <ls>Ṛs. 4. 1</ls>; so परिपक्वबुद्धिः .²4 Highly cultivated, very sharp or shrewd. .²5 Fully digested. .²6 Decaying, on the point of decay or death.
